title: Oasis Friends A-Z
hook: Water changes what can gather nearby.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: bright 3D oasis storybook, palms water and warm sand, friendly wildlife, clean centered subjects, preschool-safe

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child resting at a respectful oasis viewpoint and noticing how water changes nearby habitat
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: mark the transition from dry approach to water-and-shade center
creativeFingerprint.grooveMeter: gentle 3/4 arrival sway with cooler chorus voicing
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written oasis-centered scenes; animals may live nearby or visit, but are never forced into one drinking-party narrative
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: dry/shade/water cue -> recall beat -> target -> safe point/cup/shape gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Verses stay sparse; chorus widens; retrieval strips back. dry shaker footsteps and sparse marimba echoes with open space
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: dry shaker footsteps and sparse marimba echoes with open space
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make an oasis meaningful as a concentration of water, shade and visitors within a dry landscape: approach through heat, arrive at blue/green relief, notice who uses nearby habitat, then follow the water story into a wadi.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child approaches and rests near water; recurring language uses dry road, blue patch, shade, drink, bank, visit, leave space and water-after-rain.
imageMotifs: animal tracks near water but not crowded
semanticArc: water and shade reveal the oasis
water story expands into wadi and dry edge
